name: secondu-team-career-prep
description: Map role requirements to real experience, improve materials and test them through interview questions.

displayDescription.zh: 将岗位要求与真实经历逐项对应，打磨材料并用追问检验表达。
displayDescription.en: Map role requirements to real experience, improve materials and test them through interview questions.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据岗位说明与我的真实经历，完善求职材料并准备一轮模拟面试。
quickPrompts.en: Use the role description and my real experience to improve application materials and prepare a mock interview.

description.zh: 从原始岗位说明提炼职责、能力和评判信号，区分明确要求与推测，不推断雇主未公开偏好。交付 role.md。
description.en: Extract responsibilities, capabilities and evaluation signals from the role description; separate stated requirements from inference. Deliver role.md.

description.zh: 把用户提供的真实项目与要求对应；保留职责边界和数据出处。补充问题列为待确认，不填造履历。交付材料草稿与证据表。
description.en: Map supplied projects to requirements, preserving ownership and evidence for metrics. Leave gaps as questions rather than fabricating a resume. Deliver drafts and an evidence matrix.

description.zh: 针对证据不足、取舍和失败经验设计追问；提供评价标准及演练顺序，区分模拟答法和用户事实。交付 interview.md。
description.en: Probe evidence gaps, trade-offs and failures with evaluation criteria and a practice sequence. Distinguish example wording from user facts. Deliver interview.md.
